## About
Dent Doctor is operated by Dent Clinic, the folks who pioneered a new industry by introducing Paintless Dent Repair (PDR) to the marketplace. We're on Kenny Rd in Columbus, and we've built a 4.9 rating from 575 Google reviews.
Paintless dent repair means no body putty, no grinding, no paint, no long wait and no big bill. We work the dent out and leave your original finish intact. That matters when you sell, trade in or turn in a lease, because a preserved finish helps you avoid "diminished value."
When a dent can't come out completely, we'll tell you. One reviewer said we explained their dent was too deep to disappear completely, set realistic expectations, and then exceeded them.
Beyond dents, we handle spot painting, scratches, buffing and touchup, parts replacement, detailing, leather upholstery repair and heated seat installs. Come by for a free estimate.

## Services
- Paintless Hail Damage repair: Hail dents worked out without paint, so your original finish stays intact.
- Paintless regular dents repair: Door dings, creases, shallow and sharp dents taken out without paint, keeping your original finish.
- Dent repair with spot painting: For dents where the paint needs attention too, we repair the dent and spot paint the area.
- Scratches, buffing, and touchup: Scratches cleaned up with buffing and touchup paint.
- Autobody parts replacement: When a part can't be saved, we replace it.
- Premier high quality Detailing: Detailing to get the rest of your car looking as good as the repair.
- Leather Upholstery repair: Repair for worn or damaged leather upholstery.
- Heated seats installation: Heated seats installed in your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: How much does paintless dent repair cost?
A: It's very inexpensive. The cost is no more than 15-20% of a conventional body shop repair.

Q: How long will I be without my car?
A: Not long. You'll get your vehicle back the same day.

Q: How does the free estimate work?
A: Just come by. In less than five minutes we'll look at the damage and tell you what it'll cost.

Q: What if I'm not happy with the repair?
A: Customer satisfaction is guaranteed, or you owe nothing.

Q: What if my dent is too deep to fix completely?
A: We'll tell you up front. One reviewer said we explained their dent was too deep to disappear completely, set realistic expectations, and they ended up thrilled with the results.
